name: JSONL transcripts
summary: The agent appends every message, tool call and result to a JSON Lines file, one JSON object per line, one file per session. Resuming a session means replaying the file into context. It is the default local session store in several coding-agent CLIs.
how: Create one .jsonl file per session, keyed by session ID
Append each message, tool call and result as one JSON line as it happens
On resume, read the file back and rebuild the conversation
On compaction, append a summary entry rather than rewriting history
Delete or archive old files on a retention schedule
facts: Claude Code, pi, Codex CLI (rollout files)
UTF-8, one JSON value per line, newline-terminated
Simple and crash-tolerant, but local, unindexed and grows without bound
watchOut: Entry formats are tool-internal; Claude Code says its format changes between versions
No query or search without an extra index
Two processes writing one session interleave messages
